name: EPIC 205979216
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 6.9 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205979216 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.865937 (16th-84th percentiles 6.570477-7.191675), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205979216 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.948206 (16th-84th percentiles 0.853078-1.058909), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205979216: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4975.6245 +/- 189 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205979216 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2824.726562 (16th-84th percentiles 2717.695312-2937.265625), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.03 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,825 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.95 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,976 K at its surface.
